senses.definition: n.pr.m. (a father is Ēl; South-Arabic name) son of Joktan Gn 10:28 1 Ch 1:22. Cf. Sab. אבמעתֿתר, Abmi ʿAṯtar a father is ʿAṯtar ([עשׁתר] v. עַשְׁתֹּרֶת) HalM 86, DHMZMG 1883, 18.
